comments.body:
Can be crafted after Chapter 1 of Seven Wonders begins. Recipe:

The Statue of Osiris (base item)
Handicrafts/Alchemy r11
Sophia points: 250
Ancient Iron Meteorite x5
Phantom Monster's Relic x3
Aqua Concentrate x10
Chance of success: 40%

Note: the above formula may change on Maris server. We'll see. Cheers!
